title: FAMNIT HACKATHON 2026
description: 🚀 FAMNIT Hackathon 2026 is coming! Join us on May 16–17 for an intense 24-hour innovation challenge where creativity, technology, and teamwork collide. Students, developers, designers, and problem-solvers will come together to build exciting projects from scratch and turn bold ideas into real prototypes. Form a team, meet amazing people, and spend 24 hours creating something impactful with the support of mentors and the energy of an incredible community. During the hackathon you will: 💡 Build innovative solutions in just 24 hours 👥 Collaborate in teams and meet like-minded people 🧑‍🏫 Get guidance from experienced mentors 🛠 Experiment with new tools and technologies 🎤 Pitch your project to a panel of judge 🏆 Compete for awesome prizes and opportunities Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced hacker, this is your chance to learn, create, and challenge yourself. 📅 May 16–17, 2026 📍 University of Primorska – FAMNIT 🔥 Ready to hack? Register here: https://forms.gle/ntypyhYsJTZ1F83S7 Come build, learn, and create something unforgettable in 24 hours.

title: FAMNIT Hackathon 2026 – Info Session
description: Curious about the FAMNIT Hackathon 2026? Join our official info session to learn everything you need to know before the big 24-hour challenge! We’ll break down everything about FAMNIT Hackathon 2026 — from idea to final pitch. Learn how the 24-hour challenge works, how to form a team, what mentors expect, and how you can stand out. We’ll cover: 🧠 What the hackathon is about 👥 Who can participate 🛠 How teams work 🏆 Prizes & opportunities 📅 Timeline and important dates ❓ Live Q&A Whether you’re a beginner or experienced developer, this session will help you prepare and feel confident before registration opens. Register your spot here: https://forms.gle/ntypyhYsJTZ1F83S7

title: The first ever FAMNIT LAN Party: 2000s Throwback Edition
description: Ready to relive the golden era of LAN parties? Join us for a night where we bring back the early 2000s — local network gaming, chaotic team shouts across the room, instant rematches, and zero excuses on ping. We’ll all be connected to the same network, battling it out the way it was meant to be played. Note that you don't necessarily need to compete: you can just come and network with all of us, enjoy snacks and drinks and feel the atmosphere. Expect classics and modern favorites like: League of Legends Valorant Minecraft CS 1.6 CS:GO …and more. But this isn’t just about gaming. Between matches, we’re opening space for collaboration — bring your laptop, your ideas, and your GitHub. Want to contribute to open-source? Start a small project? Hack together something fun at 2 AM? This is your playground. 💾 Throwback vibes 🖥️ Real LAN experience 🎯 Casual and competitive matches 💡 Open-source corner for builders 🤝 Meet fellow gamers & developers Whether you’re here to clutch, build, code, or just vibe — this will be a night of nostalgia, energy, and pure campus chaos (the good kind). No lag. No limits. Just LAN.

title: Let's try to RUN it! A Competitive Programming Training
description: Think fast. Code smart. Get ready to compete. Let's try to run it is a Competitive Programming Training - a practice-focused workshop designed to prepare participants for the official competitive programming contest taking place the following week. Inspired by the PUTKA.UPM competition format, this session offers a hands-on introduction to the contest environment, rules, and problem types. The beautiful thing is that you don't need to have prior knowledge, we will learn everything needed on the spot. 📅 Date: 27.02.2026 ⏰ Time: 18:00 - 20:00 📍 Location: RLab3, FAMNIT Participants will solve tasks reused from previous years in a low-pressure test contest, allowing them to explore strategies, ask questions, and become comfortable with competitive programming workflows. ✨ Platform walkthrough (PUTKA.UPM, HackerRank) ✨ Practice problems & test contest ✨ Tips for algorithmic problem-solving 👉 Highly recommended for all participants of the main competition (but not limited) - beginners are especially welcome.

title: Study Jams with Tutors: Excel & Enjoy!
description: 📚 Study Jams with Tutors 💡 Ready to turn confusion into clarity? Join us at Study Jams with Tutors , an interactive learning session designed to help you learn smarter, not harder . Whether you’re stuck on tricky concepts, preparing for exams, or just want to sharpen your skills, this is the perfect space to ask questions, collaborate, and grow. Our tutors and GDG mentors will be there to guide you through key topics, share practical tips, and help you tackle challenges in a friendly, pressure-free environment. Expect hands-on problem solving, peer learning, and plenty of “aha!” moments. ✨ Learn together ✨ Get personalized guidance ✨ Boost your confidence Bring your questions, your curiosity, and your laptop - let’s study, jam, and level up together at UP FAMNIT !

title: The Codebreaker’s Playground: Cryptography 101
description: Join us for an exciting introduction to the world of cryptography , led by Professor Rene Rodriguez Aldama , who will guide us through the fundamentals of how information is secured, protected, and encrypted in the digital age. 📅 Date: 0 9.12.2025 🕐 Time: 18:00 - 20:00 📍 Location: RLab2, FAMNIT After the talk, we’ll move into a hands-on workshop , where you'll have the chance to implement real cryptographic techniques and explore how these concepts work in practice. No prior experience is required - just curiosity and enthusiasm! Come learn, experiment, and discover how cryptography shapes the security of our modern world! 🔒✨

title: Inside the Firewall: A Cybersecurity Talk You Won’t Forget
description: Step into the world of Cybersecurity with Nikolcho , who will be joining us online to share his personal journey, career path, and day-to-day adventures in defending the digital world. From breaking into the industry to dealing with real Cybersecurity challenges, Nikolcho will give us an inside look at what it’s like to work on the front lines of digital security 🔍. 📅 Date: 04.12.2025 🕐 Time: 18:00 - 20:00 📍 Location: Online To make the session even more memorable, he’s preparing something fun and interactive for all attendees 🎉 — so get ready to learn, laugh, and explore what it truly means to protect systems in a connected world. Don’t miss the chance to hear real stories from the Cybersecurity trenches! 💡

title: 12 Code Quests - Primorska Edition (AoC 2025)
description: 🎄 This December, Advent of Code 2025 is coming @ GDG on Campus University of Primorska! 🚀 Join us in Advent of Code — a global coding event where you solve 12 fun programming challenges released throughout the month. Perfect for sharpening your skills, competing with friends, and having fun! 🏆 Win a Prize! The top scorer on the GDG UP FAMNIT leaderboard will receive a special prize 🎁 (yes, something cool 👀). 🔗 Join our leaderboard Start solving on: https://adventofcode.com/2025/leaderboard/private Password: 4897183-89582534. 🐉 Why join? You improve your coding + compete with fellow students + maybe win a prize. Good Luck & Happy Coding. 😉

title: Vibe Coding: A Collaborative Development Workshop
description: Join us for an exciting “Vibe Coding” workshop hosted by GDG On Campus University of Primorska ! This isn’t just another coding session - it’s a chance to collaborate, learn, and create something meaningful together. You’ll work in teams to develop an engaging and impactful project that you can proudly showcase on GitHub and include in your CV. 📅 Date: 29.11.2025 🕐 Time: 15:00 - 17:00 📍 Location: FAMNIT RLab 1 (1st floor) At this workshop, you’ll: 💻 Collaborate with fellow participants on a real project - from idea to execution. 🚀 Learn new coding techniques and best practices through hands-on development. 🤝 Experience the power of teamwork in a creative and supportive environment. 🌐 Contribute to an open-source project that highlights your skills and initiative. 🎯 Build connections with other passionate tech enthusiasts and grow together. Don’t miss this opportunity to code, connect, and create ! Secure your spot and be part of something innovative - where every contribution makes a difference.

title: Meet & Greet: Discover GDG On Campus University of Primorska
description: Join us for our very first "Meet & Greet" event hosted by GDG on Campus University of Primorska! 📅 Date: 11.11.2025 🕐 Time: 18:30 - 21:00 📍 Location: Avla, FAMNIT At this event, you’ll: Learn about GDG on Campus and its mission. Meet the organizing team and find out how you can join the E-board or become a future chapter leader. Get insights into Google’s learning resources and opportunities for skill development. Network with fellow students who share your passion for technology, innovation, and collaboration. Enjoy snacks, conversations, and a welcoming atmosphere - the perfect way to start your journey with our GDG community! Don’t miss out on the start of something exciting. Let’s connect, collaborate, and grow together as we shape the future of tech at University of Primorska.

title: FAMNIT Hackathon 4.0 – Innovate, Build, Compete!
description: The FAMNIT Hackathon 4.0 is organized by Google Developer Group (GDG) On Campus at the University of Primorska. Over three intense days, students will work in teams to tackle exciting challenges provided by tech sponsors and mentors. Why Join? ✅ Work on real-world tech challenges ✅ Network with industry leaders ✅ Mentorship from experts and sponsors ✅ Workshops, networking events, and recruitment opportunities ✅ Win amazing prizes and get exclusive swag! 💡 Who can participate? This event is open to all students, whether you're a beginner or an experienced coder. Teamwork and creativity are key! MORE INFORMATION COMING SOON!

title: Crack the Code: Competitive Programming Bootcamp
description: Are you interested in competitive programming? Whether you're a beginner eager to start or a pro looking to sharpen your skills, "Crack the Code: Competitive Programming Bootcamp" is the event for you! Led by Associate Professor Nino Bašić, this workshop will guide you through:     - Thinking strategies to approach and solve challenges effectively.     - Coding techniques and the best tools for success.     - Recommended literature and resources to level up your skills.     - Practical tasks to test your knowledge and compete for a prize. 📍 Location: FAMNIT RLab 3 🕔 Time: 17:00 onwards 🍕 Snacks, drinks, coffee, and tea provided! ⚠️ Limited spaces available—RSVP now to secure your spot (first come, first served)! Don’t miss this opportunity to learn, practice, and compete in a supportive and exciting environment. See you there!

title: Meet & Greet
description: 📢 Ready to Meet and Mingle? Join us for the Google Developer Groups Meet & Greet at the University of Primorska this November! This is a relaxed and fun event for all students, no matter your background or interests. 🌐 What’s in Store? Connect with fellow students from different fields, share ideas, and discover exciting opportunities on campus. Whether you're into arts, sciences, business, management or something entirely unique, this is the perfect place to find friends, collaborators, and a community that values your perspective. 📅 Date and Time: 11.11.2024 Monday from 18:30 💡 What to Bring: Bring your ideas, questions, and an open mind! Don’t miss out on this chance to expand your circle and maybe spark a new friendship or project. We can’t wait to see you there!

title: ŠtartUP 2024/25
description: ŠtartUP - FOR A PERFECT START TO THE ACADEMIC YEAR  ŠtartUP is a sports and social event organized by the University of Primorska, with which we start the new academic year together. We invite you to join us on Saturday, October 5, 2024, from 10:00 to 16:00 at Žusterna Seaside Park. (*In case of bad weather, the event will be moved to Taverna Koper). The event is open to all students at the University of Primorska, both freshmen and seniors. The event provides an opportunity for networking between freshman and senior students. Networking with colleagues from the University's teaching and professional staff adds a special touch to the event. The venue offers a relaxed atmosphere by the sea, so it is advisable to bring a picnic blanket or beach towel. Lunch and coffee will be provided for registered participants. PROGRAM The event will take place from 10:00 to 16:00 in Žusterna Seaside Park, Koper. (in case of bad weather, it will be moved to Taverna Koper) o A presentation of all the faculties of the University of Primorska, centres and units where students can get involved in extra-curricular activities. o More than 55 participating local organisations, associations, institutions and companies have prepared fun activities to show you how to get involved and participate in the extracurricular activities while studying. o Sports activities organised by ŠportUP (the official recreation for UP students), which will provide sports activities such as badminton, "štrbunk", zorbing and paddling ACCOMPANYING PROGRAMME 10:15 Meditation with gongs / Sandra Majcen (30-40 min) 12:00 Official opening with the Rector and the MOK representative (15 min) 12:15 EuropeDirect StandUP - Jan David Kljenak (20 min) 12:35 EuropeDirect StandUP - Benjamin Kovač Keber (20min) 13:00 Lunch 14:00 Animation program - Salsa with Fuego Latino, Irish dance, cycling, Capoeira .
